source.dataset: Paradigm / Brussels-Capital Region UrbIS raster orthophoto

circular_basin_witness.method: deterministic Hough-circle candidate checked against the lawful orthophoto crop

reference_alignment_audit.meaning: The current circular basin is not collinear with the source-published Commons camera and the current project Atomium anchor. Do not treat the published camera coordinate as sufficient proof of the 2006 fountain composition.
reference_alignment_audit.historical_limit: The orthophoto is current 2024 evidence; it does not prove that the 2006 photographed fountain occupied exactly the same geometry.

hard_limits: No jet count, jet height, wall height, stone material or plumbing geometry is established by this evidence.
The circle supports a current basin footprint candidate only.
Do not move the basin to force the 2006 photo composition.
Do not move the Commons camera to force alignment without a separate geolocation audit.
